theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (F : Euclid n → Euclid P) (B : Set (Euclid n)) (J : Euclid n → ℝ) (b : Euclid n) (r : ℝ) (f : Euclid P → ℝ), Continuous F → MeasurableSet B → Measurable J → (∀ a, 0 ≤ J a) → (∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, ∫⁻ y in F '' B, g y ∂μHE[n] = ∫⁻ x in B, ENNReal.ofReal (J x) * g (F x) ∂volume) → 0 < r → Continuous f → ∫ z in Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap (F b) r '' (F '' B), f z ∂μHE[n] = ∫ c, B.indicator J (b + r • c) * f (r⁻¹ • (F (b + r • c) - F b)) ∂volume
